# Delphic Observatory — full agent context

> Delphic is a public, read-only projection over canonical GitHub evidence. GitHub owns repository source, research lane architecture, issue and pull-request state, schemas, CI receipts and release provenance. Vercel and GitHub Pages are static presentation targets. Render is an optional free-tier feed cache behind an explicit provisioning gate.

## Authority and state
The observatory displays public repository activity and research-lane navigation. It carries zero dispatch, participant provisioning, quota consumption, paid fallback, wallet mutation, culling, policy override or evidence-promotion authority. Feed failure maps to unavailable or degraded state with observation timestamps. Missing data stays unknown.

## Spatial model
- LEFT — evidence field: tensor, graph, matrix, constellation, source artefacts and immutable receipts.
- NOW — decision windows: cadence, dependencies, quality, complexity, resource cost, uncertainty and provenance.
- RIGHT — interthreading: DAG, trellis, Markov paths and cross-lane decision lineage.

## Lane families
foresight-radar; ai-technology; science-research; foss-developer-tools; emerging-technology; agent-observability; multi-agent-evaluation; reproducible-environments; local-edge-arm-android; agentic-security; malware-reverse-engineering; provenance-supply-chain; accelerators-materials-energy; procurement-opportunities.

## Feed contract
The UI reads public GitHub pull-request and Actions endpoints. The client refreshes on a bounded cadence and presents freshness and failure state. The optional Render adapter exposes /healthz, /api/pulls and /api/actions/runs with schema, source, observation timestamp and stale metadata. GitHub direct mode remains the fallback.

## Cost contract
Prefer free tiers, local execution and verified credits. Require explicit approval for paid usage and credit consumption. Record eligibility, expiry, quota and owner. Render free service behavior, including sleep and cold starts, remains part of service selection. Vercel Hobby eligibility and usage limits require account-side verification.
